card.name: Systemic absorption of topical drugs
card.fires_on: The word systemic (or its ending -ic after System) and the following exposure or absorption, mostly in warnings about topical corticosteroids or bladder drugs. It also fires weakly on a few modifier endings such as -dimensional and -handled.

modes.label: Systemic exposure/absorption
modes.description: The word systemic or the ending of System-ic, just before absorption or exposure.

modes.label: Descriptive shape/form words
modes.description: Endings of descriptive modifiers or nouns that describe form or distribution.

card.plain: It marks the phrase systemic absorption or exposure in warnings about drugs applied to the skin or bladder.
